subgoals.description: Research and compile a list of potential venues in Edinburgh with basic details
subgoals.success_criterion: List of 3-5 venues including name, location, and contact information

subgoals.description: Select the most suitable venue and gather detailed information (capacity, pricing, amenities)
subgoals.success_criterion: Detailed data collected for one venue including address, capacity, price range, and key features

subgoals.description: Draft a professional flyer using the selected venue's details
subgoals.success_criterion: Complete flyer text created with venue name, description, event details, and contact info
